summary: This skill should be used when the user asks about Evite events or invitations. Triggers on phrases like "check Evite", "my Evite events", "who RSVP'd", "Evite guest list", "RSVP to the party", "message my Evite guests", "create an Evite invite", or any request involving event invitations, guest lists, RSVPs, or party/event hosting on evite.com.
